# Ng Lih Sheng

Ng Lih Sheng is a full-stack software developer in Singapore building enterprise web applications and workflow automation with TypeScript, React, Next.js, PHP, Laravel and AWS, and exploring AI agents and AI-native development.

## Projects

- [Trip Planner](https://lihsheng.space/projects/trip-planner): A collaborative, map-first workspace for planning a trip and running each travel day (React, Supabase)
- [Ops Room](https://lihsheng.space/projects/ops-room): Control surface for coding agents with an automated PR review and repair loop (TypeScript, GitHub Apps)
- [LinkUp](https://lihsheng.space/projects/linkup): Maps Excel workbooks into a target JSON schema with AI-assisted column matching (Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL)
- [AnyDraw](https://lihsheng.space/projects/anydraw): Lucky draw tools for events and classrooms (Vue 3)
- [Duty Roster](https://lihsheng.space/projects/duty-roster): Cleaning duties and routine tasks with automated scheduling (Node, React)
- [Context Hopper](https://lihsheng.space/projects/context-hopper): VS Code extension that bundles files and notes into context for AI chats (TypeScript)
